scope: Same-latent original/joint RGB around seam 84→85; appearance diagnostic, not new camera-control outcomes.

observations: At frame 85, separate-block output has a conspicuous increase in contrast/saturation relative to adjacent frames in both arms.
Joint decoding of the same latents visibly suppresses this pulse while retaining recognizable scene content in the inspected seam samples.
This appearance change does not identify physical camera velocity or establish improved camera-control efficacy.
cases.classification: Visible decoder/export contribution to the boundary contrast pulse; offline diagnostic only.
